changeSet.author: art-claude-dev
changeSet.comment:
Backing table for the V2 Shortener/Redirect Service (see ARCHITECTURE.md, section 4.2 and section 6, Scenario A/C; Day 2, Task #9). This module owns its own Liquibase changelog even though it shares the same physical Postgres instance as v1-legacy-monolith and analytics-worker: Liquibase tracks changesets by the (id, author, filename) triple in a shared DATABASECHANGELOG table, so there is no collision as long as ids stay unique per file, which they do here.
owner_user_id deliberately stores the raw Keycloak "sub" claim (a string) rather than a foreign key to an "app_user" table: no such table is in scope for this exercise (ARCHITECTURE.md's data model documents it, but nothing in the Day 1-3 plan schedules building it), and the Resource Server (Task #8) already gives us a verified subject claim per request with no extra lookup needed. Declared simplification, not an oversight.
